name: Critical Mass
effect: Fortress cannon damage x10 from its first burst, multiplying again with every burst after.

name: Regen
effect: Your fortress heals 10% of its max health every 5 seconds.

name: Drop Signal

name: Death Gerbils

name: Boss Slayer
